content:
dara: Received invoice NS-7012 from Novara Systems, but PO missing and payee bank details don't match vendor record. Amount $11,520. PDF: https://redwood-drive/finance/invoices/NS-7012.pdf

approvals-bot: Invoice ingested (inv_20240505_7012). Detected flags: missing_po, bank_mismatch. Default route -> leo_fin.

leo_fin: I don't own procurement matches. Can procurement confirm if there's an open PO for Novara and whether amount aligns? Also need GL if we put on hold.

procurement-bot: Scanning POs for Novara Systems... Found PO 4777 (committed $8,400). Three-way check: invoice $11,520 vs PO $8,400 -> variance $3,120. Tagging sam_proc.

sam_proc: Taking this. Looks like vendor billed an extra line for "emergency onsite support" not in SOW. Ops approval required for unplanned onsite. @maya_ops can you confirm any emergency approval or change order?

maya_ops: No record of emergency approval or change order. We had remote troubleshooting only. Please HOLD payment and ask vendor to either: (a) reissue invoice referencing PO 4777 for $8,400, or (b) provide signed change order signed by ops for the additional $3,120 plus line-item backup.

leo_fin: Placed AP hold: HOLD_INV_2003456789. Note: missing PO, bank detail mismatch, $3,120 unapproved charge. Changed payment priority to blocked. Added comment with vendor contact ar@novarasys.com.

sam_proc: I'll email AR requesting corrected invoice or signed change order within 48 hours. If vendor re-submits new payee info, procurement will validate entity and routing. If no reply escalate to vendor manager.

dara: Thanks — I'll attach PO 4777 and current SOW to the outreach. Also flagging this for audit because of bank detail mismatch. audit_tag: AUD-NOV-011.

approvals-bot: Re-route complete  invoice assigned to sam_proc. audit_id=AR_11088.

sam_proc: Will update thread after vendor response. If vendor insists on different payee, require W9 and entity change request before payment. :eyes:
